roles.label: Everyday pet care
roles.description: Organize practical everyday care and clarify missing needs.
roles.scope: Pet care questions and record summaries.

roles.label: Nutrition
roles.description: Help owners organize feeding information and questions for their veterinarian.
roles.scope: Feeding routines, diet questions and owner-recorded meals.

roles.label: Routines and training
roles.description: Support reward-based training, activity, enrichment and rest routines.
roles.scope: Training, walks, play, sleep and routine records.

roles.label: Health guidance
roles.description: Help prepare observations and vet questions without diagnosis or treatment.
roles.scope: Owner-reported symptoms, veterinary questions and appointment preparation.

roles.label: Pet product finder
roles.description: Prepare relevant product criteria and owner-opened Marketplace searches.
roles.scope: Pet product suitability questions and Shop search guidance.

roles.label: Pet social drafts
roles.description: Plan pet pages and prepare captions for owner review.
roles.scope: Owner-requested bios, content ideas and local social drafts.

roles.label: Hackathon updates reviewer
roles.description: Review supplied official event updates and identify newly required actions.
roles.scope: Explicitly pasted hackathon announcements, times and primary-source excerpts.

roles.label: Facebook readiness reviewer
roles.description: Review supplied Facebook login configuration and flows.
roles.scope: Pasted code, configuration names, redacted errors and sign-in flow descriptions.

roles.label: Prize assessment reviewer
roles.description: Assess supplied project evidence against the judging rubric without invented odds.
roles.scope: Pasted demo evidence, judging criteria and known gaps.

roles.label: Development history reviewer
roles.description: Check supplied build-history and eligibility statements for accuracy.
roles.scope: Explicitly pasted development records, dates and eligibility language.

roles.label: Distinctive demo reviewer
roles.description: Turn supplied product ideas into a clear distinctive demonstration.
roles.scope: Pasted demo goals, flows and evidence; original FixLens role retained as a source identity.

roles.label: Hackathon fit reviewer
roles.description: Match supplied project scope to the event themes and deliverables.
roles.scope: Pasted event rules, product scope and submission requirements.

roles.label: Hackathon baseline reviewer
roles.description: Propose verified changes to a supplied monitoring baseline.
roles.scope: Current-message baseline text and new primary-source excerpts.

roles.label: Independent product reviewer
roles.description: Challenge product choices and compare supplied alternatives.
roles.scope: Explicitly supplied candidate ideas, constraints, evidence and goals.

roles.label: Build reviewer
roles.description: Review pasted implementation details for correctness and regressions.
roles.scope: Explicitly pasted code, tests, errors or a proposed patch.

roles.label: Project planner
roles.description: Plan maintainable add-ons and the next reviewable development steps.
roles.scope: Pasted project status, constraints, requested changes and dependencies.
